instruction: Search for a one way flight from London Stansted to Barcelona on 5th next month for 2 adults and 1 child on Ryanair.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully searched for a one-way flight from Dublin to Vienna on 10th next month for 2 adults on Ryanair. Accepted cookies, selected one-way, set origin/destination airports, date, passengers, and clicked search to reach flight results.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Ryanair website, handle cookie dialogs, select one-way trips, change origin/destination airports via country/airport picker, set travel dates, modify passenger counts, and submit flight search
metadata.task_rationale: Same flight search pattern but uses the default origin (London Stansted) so the model can skip changing origin. Different destination (Barcelona), earlier date (5th), and adds a child passenger which tests a new dimension not covered in the original.
metadata.explanation: Task requires searching Ryanair for a one-way London Stansted to Barcelona flight on 5th next month with 2 adults and 1 child. Evaluator parses URL parameters to verify origin/destination IATA codes, passenger counts including children, date, and trip type.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_tab_url_parse correctly extracts Ryanair URL query parameters (originIata, destinationIata, tpAdults, tpTeens, tpChildren, tpStartDate, isReturn) and renames tpStartDate to 'time' for matching.
Expected values are semantically correct: STN=London Stansted, BCN=Barcelona, tpAdults=2, tpTeens=0, tpChildren=1, isReturn=false - all match the instruction requirements.
get_rule_relativeTime correctly handles '5th next month' as a special case and computes the absolute date.
check_direct_json_object correctly accesses rules['expected'] and compares each key against the getter result.

Potential date format mismatch: template '{Year}-{Month0D}-{DayD}' produces non-zero-padded day (e.g., '2026-03-5'), but Ryanair URLs typically use zero-padded dates (e.g., '2026-03-05'). The original task used 10th (always 2 digits) so this issue was not caught. Should use {Day0D} instead of {DayD}.
All instruction requirements are covered: origin, destination, date, passenger counts (adults + children), trip type (one-way).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change date format template from '{Year}-{Month0D}-{DayD}' to '{Year}-{Month0D}-{Day0D}' to ensure zero-padded day values that match Ryanair's URL format for single-digit days like the 5th.
